name: Hair By Lisa M
description: Hair By Lisa M is Lisa Marie's salon and mobile hair service in Port St. Lucie and surrounding areas — blondes and custom color, keratin and Brazilian blowouts, extensions, cuts, and full hair transformations from a stylist with 20+ years of experience.

hero.title: Beautiful hair. Confident you.
hero.subtitle: Blondes, custom color, keratin, extensions, and luxury blowouts — in the salon or at your door across Port St. Lucie. New clients: root touch-up + haircut for just $100.

stylists.name: Lisa Marie
stylists.title: Owner & Hairstylist
stylists.bio: Hi, I'm Lisa Marie! Originally from Brooklyn, New York, I'm a passionate hairstylist with over 20 years of experience in making women feel beautiful and confident. I'm here to help you look and feel your absolute best — in my salon or with mobile services across Port St. Lucie and surrounding areas.

reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.text: Lisa Marie is a blonde genius! My color is bright, soft, and exactly what I wanted. Twenty years of experience really shows.

reviews.name: Danielle C.
reviews.text: She came to my house for my Brazilian blowout and it was amazing. Smooth, shiny hair for months.

reviews.name: Melissa A.
reviews.text: The new client special was such a great deal — fresh roots and a gorgeous cut. I'm a client for life!

reviews.name: Stephanie G.
reviews.text: Lisa made me feel beautiful and confident. Warm, talented, and so professional.

contact.address: Serving Port St. Lucie & surrounding areas (salon & mobile)
